study: band reachability -- can every declared verdict happen?
why: three studies in a row carried a band that could not do what it was written to do, all decidable from the band and the unit count alone

problems: PASS UNREACHABLE: needs 6 of 8 but at most 4 are scorable once 4 leave the pool
PERFECT SCORES AS FAILURE: a flawless 4/4 falls inside the failure region (<= 4)
SINGLE-UNIT VETO: stated as a conjunction over all 4 units, so one marginal unit decides the study-level verdict

rows.inner: a modality dead on both its encoders
problems: CLAUSE IS IMPLIED: a modality dead on both its encoders forces the count into the 3-4 of 6 modality-dependent band, so the conjunction adds nothing
